cr_data.provenance:
1919-1984 collection of the artist; 1984-1991 collection of Emily Fisher Landau, New York, New York (sold through the artist); 1991 Whitney Museum of American Art, New York (gift of Emily Fisher Landau) 
(Source: Whitney Museum of American Art, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "See gallery photograph 2–b." Abiquiú Notebooks notes Pan American Federation of Arts label and indicates, "Back: Initials and star" [not verified]. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1919. Backing inscription dates 1918. Dated 1918 on basis of similarities to cat. nos. 256, 257. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 13. Titled *No. 2 – Music – Pink – Blue* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph; reproduced and titled *Painting* in *Playboy* (July 1924). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
